description: Per-account overrides extracted from signed agreements. Highest authority tier. Accounts absent from this file fall back to the default policy rules, so new accounts need no code change.

sla.quote: For Northstar Logistics, the following first-response targets replace ParcelPilot's standard support-policy targets: P1: 15 minutes, 24x7; P2: 1 hour; P3: 8 business hours.

cancellation.quote: Northstar may cancel any BOOKED shipment before pickup with no cancellation fee, regardless of how long ago the shipment was booked. Once a shipment is PICKED_UP, the standard return-to-origin process applies.

service_credit.quote: Monthly aggregate service credits are capped at INR 5,000. Unless this agreement states otherwise, the current ParcelPilot service-credit SOP applies.

sla.quote: P1: 2 business hours; P2: 4 business hours; P3: 2 business days. No weekend or after-hours support coverage.

cancellation.quote: No special cancellation-fee waiver applies. Use the current ParcelPilot Cancellation & Service Credit SOP.

service_credit.quote: If a pickup is more than 4 hours past the end of the scheduled pickup window, the carrier is at fault, and the customer is not at fault, LumenWorks receives a fixed INR 300 service credit. This clause replaces the default failed-pickup credit amount and timing threshold in the SOP.
